data.name: Hawlah
data.gender_notes: Hawlah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘hawlah’, meaning ‘wind’ or ‘breeze’. It symbolizes the gentle and soothing touch of the wind, which brings comfort and relief. The name Hawlah carries the meaning “Wind, breeze, gentle breeze” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Hawlah usually hope their child will grow to embody wind, breeze, gentle breeze and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle touch of Allah, providing comfort and relief to those in need.
data.etymology: Hawlah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wind, breeze, gentle breeze.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hawlah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: هولة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني التغيير أو التحول في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم هولة هو اسم مؤنث عربي الأصل، مشتق من الفعل هول والذي يعني التغيير أو التحول. يستخدم هذا الاسم في اللغة العربية لوصف الشخصية التي تتسم بالتغيير أو التحول، وقد ورد في بعض المصادر العربية القديمة كاسم للنساء اللاتي يتميزن بالتغيير في حياتهن أو في شخصياتهن.

in_urdu.name: ہولہ
in_urdu.meaning: اسم ہولہ مطلب ہے تبدیلی یا تبدیل ہونے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہولہ ایک مؤنث اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے تبدیلی یا تبدیل ہونے والا۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام ان خواتین کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو اپنی زندگی یا شخصیت میں تبدیلی لانے کی خصوصیت رکھتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: होला
in_hindi.meaning: होला नाम का अर्थ है परिवर्तन या बदलाव
in_hindi.long_meaning: होला एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है परिवर्तन या बदलाव। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन महिलाओं के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अपने जीवन या व्यक्तित्व में परिवर्तन लाने की विशेषता रखती हैं।

in_english.name: Hawlah
in_english.meaning: Hawlah means change or transformation in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Hawlah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. It is derived from the Arabic verb 'hawla', which means to change or transform. In Islamic tradition, the name Hawlah is associated with women who bring about change or transformation in their lives or communities. The name has historical significance and is mentioned in some Arabic sources as a name for women known for their transformative impact.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Hawlah" has a rich cultural significance, as it is reminiscent of the tranquil and calming effect of the wind. In various Islamic traditions, the wind is considered a symbol of purity, change, and renewal. The name can be given to girls as a reminder of the refreshing and cleansing power of the wind, inspiring them to carry the qualities of gentleness, serenity, and adaptability throughout their lives.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Hawlah" evokes a sense of connection to the natural world and the Creator. It highlights the omnipresence of God in all aspects of our lives, even the seemingly insignificant things like the wind. The name serves as a reminder of the peace and relief that comes from placing faith and trust in the divine plan, even when circumstances feel chaotic and uncertain. Through this name, the individual is encouraged to seek solace in the gentle and soothing presence of the Divine and find strength in the face of adversity.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Hajar al-Haytami mentions Hawlah as a name for a mosque in Damascus in his book Al-Fatawa Al-Hadithah.
Historical records show that Al-Maqrizi records the name Hawlah for a mosque in Damascus in his book Al-Itqan fi Ulum al-Quran. The name Hawlah carried significant weight in that era.
